sections.heading: Keeping track of your super
sections.text:
How to keep track of your super accounts. Find, recover and consolidate lost super.

QC23228

Access secure services, view your details and lodge online.

Use ATO online services to track your super and find any accounts you have forgotten or lost touch with.

Use this checklist to review the health of your super.

When and how you can transfer or roll over your super to another fund, and how to consolidate multiple super accounts.

Find out if the ATO holds super that belongs to you, how you can recover and transfer it into an account of your choice.

What happens to inactive super accounts, and find out how you can recover an inactive super account.
